Container.Name: ancestry-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes your Ancestry.com family tree to Claude.ai. Export your tree as a GEDCOM from Ancestry.com, place it in the mapped data path, and Claude can search people, browse family relationships, and explore ancestors and descendants. Data is automatically filtered to individuals born 1900 or later.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Use this port when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory for your GEDCOM export and the processed JSON. Place your Ancestry.com GEDCOM export here as 'ancestry.ged'. The container will process it into 'ancestry.json' on startup.

Config.Name: OAuth Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth client ID for securing the MCP endpoint. Used with Claude.ai remote MCP integration.

Config.Name: OAuth Client Secret
Config.Description: OAuth client secret / bearer token for securing the MCP endpoint. If set, all MCP requests must include this as a Bearer token.
